sheets.name: run_1

sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his blue webbed foot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the tendrils and the trident follow the pale figure. The trident is NOT a leg: his two legs with the webbed feet carry him.

sheets.weapons: THE TRIDENT goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): the trident with its three dark teal prongs, dark red shaft and butt ring, as long as in image 1 - held level, slanted behind him, raised, slammed down, or planted upright under him as the pale figure holds it (lying beside him when he dies). The long tendrils and the fin follow his head. Only him: no water, no splashes, no fish, no shark, no dash streaks, no glow.
